title: (Scripture Reading Exercise.)
author: B. H. Roberts
note: Fifth Year (final) of the Seventy's Course in Theology. Focuses on divine immanence, the Holy Spirit, and nature of God.

footnotes.text: Book of Moses (Pearl of Great Price), ch. vi:48-68.

Eph. iv:4-6. "One Lord, one faith, one baptism." "I further believe in the gift of the Holy Ghost by the laying on of hands. . . . . You might as well baptize a bag of sand as a man, if not done in view of the remission of sins and getting of the Holy Ghost. Baptism by water is but half a baptism, and is good for nothing without the other half--that is, the baptism of the Holy Ghost." (Joseph Smith's Discourse at Nauvoo, July 9th, 1843, History of the Church, Vol. V, p. 499.)
